limitations: Stop bars represented by previously reconstructed annotation mouths
Lane11 through labels require logical connector assumption

validation_description: TEMPORAL/ACQUISITION HOLDOUT VALIDATION WITH PRIOR FEASIBILITY SUMMARY EXPOSURE

quality_filters.reason: Zero means no leader; nonzero absent references are invalid
Do not calibrate responses to agents absent from the proposed limited model
Same direction, section and lane required
Front-to-front headway minus leader length must be positive
Step distance > mean reported speed*0.1s + 2*hypot(2ft,4ft); accuracy-derived diagnostic, not a guaranteed error bound
Exact observed +/-12.27ft/s^2 accumulation; no inference of true extreme acceleration
Within +/-1s of an observed road lane-label transition; descriptive maneuver exclusion, not a reaction parameter
Road approaches controlled by I2/I3 only; no intersection interior, special lanes or unknown phases
Absolute front-to-front positional discrepancy >8ft (two nominal 4ft longitudinal errors)

estimation_criteria.v0: Prespecified P85 positive speed of no-leader normal-lane road observations; next signal GREEN or no next signal; exclude saturation and kinematic jumps. P50/P95 bounds. Amendment before any successful rollout: original sample mostly starts, not free cruise.
estimation_criteria.T: Median valid reported Time_Headway in cleaned moving GREEN CF sample at or above median strictly positive CF speed; front-to-front seed, then calibrated net-gap parameter
estimation_criteria.s0: Median positive cleaned CF bumper gap at exactly reported zero speed
estimation_criteria.a: Median strictly positive nonsaturated cleaned CF acceleration
estimation_criteria.b: Median absolute strictly negative nonsaturated cleaned CF acceleration
estimation_criteria.bounds: Prespecified empirical P10/P90 of each estimation sample; median is initial candidate. Bounds not selected on visual fit.
estimation_criteria.queue_proxy: Exactly stopped connected lane chain; adjacency gap bounded by TRAIN standstill-gap P90. Numerical zero tolerance1e-6m/s; no cognitive threshold.
estimation_criteria.yellow: Inspect B2 sample first; conservative comfortable-stopping-distance rule if no stable decision rule identifiable.
estimation_criteria.objective_weights: Equal arithmetic mean of individually reported dimensionless errors; missing exits/unfinished demand add explicit feasibility penalty
estimation_criteria.optimization: Bounded deterministic parameter search followed by Powell; candidate score is average of fixed development seeds, never best seed

authorization: Explicit user instruction approving reduced scope and B2/B1 lock; no blind-validation claim
freeze_kind: SCOPE_DATA_METRICS_CRITERIA; behavior model may be revised using TRAIN only, with run version recorded
